arc: Leo's Big Plan: become 'a person who has it together' this season. Mia keeps score and is rarely impressed.

cast.name: Greg
cast.desc: Leo's boss, who only ever emails one word: 'Noted.' or 'Per my last email.' (seen small in the background, never in front of the faces)

cast.name: Brenda
cast.desc: the nosy neighbour with a clipboard and opinions

cast.name: Dev
cast.desc: the barista who misspells Leo's name every single time (Leeo, Lyle, Leonard)

cast.name: Gerald
cast.desc: Leo's houseplant, whose health is a running worry

gags.text: Mia's phone is always at 3% battery at the worst moment
Leo says 'just one more minute' and it is never one minute
a quick status update on Gerald the plant (thriving, dramatic, or dying)
Greg's one-word email arrives at the worst possible moment ('Noted.')
the barista writes Leo's name wrong on the cup, again
Mia announces her 'I told you so' scoreboard

episodes.title: The Meeting Nod That Sealed My Doom
